details: The orphan worker was reparented to PID 1, its source checkout was gone, and its synthetic manifest referenced a missing tmux session.
lsof showed more than 3,000 duplicate read-only descriptors for the run directory after roughly four hours of five-second retries.
The process-only recovery stopped PID 20177; a positive ps check confirmed it exited and no live loop was affected.
Three consecutive retry wake cycles create exactly one run-directory watcher.
The watcher remains open between cycles and watcher plus metadata probe each close exactly once when the session exits.
The actual bridge worker constructs one wake session for its full loop and closes it in the worker finally path.
Every sequential test file passed outside the restricted sandbox.
The sandboxed proxy integration could not bind loopback and returned EADDRINUSE; the same exact test passed outside the sandbox with 1 test, 0 failures, and 6 expectations.

known_limitations: This candidate is not integrated, installed, or deployed.
Filesystem watch remains an optimization; the metadata version probe and five-minute reconciliation remain authoritative fallbacks.
